settings.headline: Bring your business data together.
settings.intro: TraceKit is designed to connect evidence across acquisition, attribution, commerce, and financial systems. Integration availability and depth vary by provider.
settings.note: Featured platform logos indicate ecosystem relevance, not universal live connector availability.

settings.heading: Advertising and traffic
settings.body: Connect relevant campaign and traffic evidence to customer journeys where supported.

settings.heading: Affiliate attribution
settings.body: Preserve provider click and transaction identifiers and reconcile them with commercial activity.

settings.heading: Commerce and checkout
settings.body: Relate orders, upsells, subscriptions, refunds, and other events without flattening their source history.

settings.heading: Payments and disputes
settings.body: Bring payment, refund, and chargeback evidence into the financial picture when supported.

settings.heading: Integration status
settings.body: Confirm the specific connector, permissions, sync scope, and readiness for your environment before deployment.
